page.title: NIS2 Risk Assessment
page.subtitle: Eight questions per asset. Per-Grundwert Schutzbedarf and a recommended Absicherungsvariante in the spirit of BSI Grundschutz 200-2 §8.2.
page.metaTitle: NIS2 Risk Assessment. Free, no signup
page.metaDescription: Free 8-question heuristic in the spirit of BSI Grundschutz 200-2 §8.2 Schutzbedarfsfeststellung. Per-Grundwert classification (V/I/A → normal/hoch/sehr hoch) with Maximum-Prinzip aggregation and a recommended Absicherungsvariante.

hero.headline: NIS2 Risk Assessment
hero.subhead: Eight questions per asset. Per-Grundwert protection-need and a recommended implementation path in the spirit of BSI Grundschutz 200-2 §8.2.

intro.trustLine: Per-Grundwert (V/I/A) classification with Maximum-Prinzip. NIS2 Art 21(1) + Art 21(2)(a), BSIG §30. No signup, the result stays with you.
intro.inventoryHint: Once you have your inventory from Lesson 2.2 of our CEO course, every asset takes under a minute.

example.label: Example result
example.tierExplanation: Basis-Absicherung recommended; Schutzbedarf normal on all three Grundwerte.

basis.label: Basis
basis.description: Basis-Absicherung: broad shallow entry, minimum-effort Bausteine. Acceptable for assets with normal Schutzbedarf on all Grundwerte and no severe implementation hints.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Standard-Absicherung: full Grundschutz Bausteine at full implementation depth. Certifiable per ISO 27001 on the basis of IT-Grundschutz. Required when any Grundwert reaches hoch or when implementation hints are severe.

kern.label: Kern
kern.description: Kern-Absicherung: concentrate full Standard-depth implementation on this asset as a Kronjuwel. The Kern Vorgehensweise focuses ISMS effort on assets with sehr hoch Schutzbedarf first.

schutzbedarf.heading: BSI-200-2 §8.2 Schutzbedarfsfeststellung
schutzbedarf.subtitle: Per-Grundwert classification (Vertraulichkeit, Integrität, Verfügbarkeit) on the scale normal / hoch / sehr hoch. The highest of the three sets the Gesamt-Schutzbedarf (Maximum-Prinzip).

v.description: How sensitive is the data? Would unauthorised access cause harm?

i.description: How critical is data accuracy? Would tampering, fraud, or corruption cause harm?

a.description: How available must it be? What's the consequence of downtime?

schutzbedarf.gesamtBody: Maximum-Prinzip: the highest of the three Grundwerte sets the overall Schutzbedarf. Driving Grundwert here: <grundwert></grundwert>.

variante.heading: Recommended Absicherungsvariante
variante.subtitle: The implementation path (BSI-200-2 §3.4) suggested by your Gesamt-Schutzbedarf. Basis/Standard/Kern are BSI's three Vorgehensweisen. Distinct from the Schutzbedarfsklassen above.

basis.description: Basis-Absicherung is a fast-start entry path with a reduced subset of Bausteine. Acceptable when Schutzbedarf is normal on all Grundwerte and implementation hints are mild.

standard.description: Standard-Absicherung implements all Grundschutz Bausteine at full depth. BSI's recommended choice for most Mittelstand assets and the only Vorgehensweise that supports ISO 27001 certification on the basis of IT-Grundschutz.

kern.description: Kern-Absicherung concentrates full Standard-depth implementation on this asset as a Kronjuwel. The Kern Vorgehensweise prioritises ISMS effort on the most critical assets first. Typical for assets with sehr hoch Schutzbedarf.

variante.bumpedTitle: Lifted from Basis to Standard by implementation hints
variante.bumpedBody: Your Gesamt-Schutzbedarf is normal, but one or more implementation hints (Schwachstellen / Eintrittswahrscheinlichkeit, BSI-200-3 territory) is severe enough that the reduced Bausteine subset of Basis-Absicherung is unlikely to be sufficient. The following hints triggered the lift:
variante.risikoanalyseBody: When at least one Grundwert reaches hoch or sehr hoch, BSI-200-3 ergänzende Risikoanalyse is mandatory for this asset (BSI-200-2 §8.5). This tool does not perform that analysis. It identifies that it is required. Standard-Absicherung plus a scenario-based risk analysis is the documented path.

personalData.question: What kind of data does this system process?

none.label: No personal or specially regulated data
none.why: Vertraulichkeit-Schutzbedarf normal. No DSGVO or sector-specific elevated protection duty.

employeeOnly.label: Employee data (HR files, contracts, salaries)
employeeOnly.why: Vertraulichkeit-Schutzbedarf normal. DSGVO applies; standard TOMs per Art 32 DSGVO sufficient.

customer.label: Customer data or operational business data (bulk)
customer.why: Vertraulichkeit-Schutzbedarf hoch. Bulk customer or commercially-sensitive business data sets the protection-need floor at hoch. Standard TOMs plus processor agreements required. BSI-200-3 Risikoanalyse required.

sensitivePii.label: Sensitive data: Art 9 DSGVO (health, religion) or regulated operational data (OT, KRITIS)
sensitivePii.why: Vertraulichkeit-Schutzbedarf hoch as a floor. Art 9 DSGVO data triggers Art 35 Data Protection Impact Assessment. With high user volume or external access, Kumulationseffekt §8.2.4 can lift to sehr hoch. BSI-200-3 Risikoanalyse required.

integrity.question: If data in this system got tampered with (wrong invoices, fake records, modified transactions), how bad would it be?

minor.label: Doesn't really matter. Small errors would be caught easily and fixed
minor.why: Integrität-Schutzbedarf normal. Standard backups and basic audit trails sufficient.

moderate.label: Some impact. Wrong data would cause operational confusion or take time to fix
moderate.why: Integrität-Schutzbedarf normal. Standard backups, audit trails, and routine reconciliation sufficient.

high.label: Significant. Wrong data could cause financial loss, regulatory issues, or customer harm
high.why: Integrität-Schutzbedarf hoch. Anti-tampering controls, comprehensive change logging, and review workflows required. BSI-200-3 Risikoanalyse required.

critical.label: Critical. Wrong data could cause major financial loss, legal liability, or safety risks
critical.why: Integrität-Schutzbedarf sehr hoch. Strong anti-tampering (signing, hashing), four-eyes review, non-repudiation. BSI-200-3 Risikoanalyse required. Kern-Absicherung candidate.

downtimeTolerance.question: How long until customers or operations notice this system is down?

days.label: Days. We'd manage with workarounds.
days.why: Verfügbarkeit-Schutzbedarf normal. Standard backups; Grundschutz CON.3 applies.

hours.label: Hours. Customers or operations would notice.
hours.why: Verfügbarkeit-Schutzbedarf hoch. Grundschutz CON.3 and emergency planning required. BSI-200-3 Risikoanalyse required.

minutes.label: Minutes. Operations stop immediately.
minutes.why: Verfügbarkeit-Schutzbedarf sehr hoch. Redundancy, automatic failover, tested emergency plans required. NIS2 Art 21(2)(c) load-bearing. BSI-200-3 Risikoanalyse required.

userCount.question: Who has access to this system?

tiny.label: A few standard users (small team, no special privileges)
tiny.why: No Kumulationseffekt. Standard access controls sufficient (Grundschutz ORP.4).

small.label: Many standard users (whole departments, all without special privileges)
small.why: No Kumulationseffekt at this scale. Structured role management and regular access reviews. NIS2 Art 21(2)(i).

large.label: Includes privileged users (admins, finance, executives)
large.why: Kumulationseffekt §8.2.4: with high-V data (customer or sensitive), V-Schutzbedarf can lift one level. Strict role separation, MFA on privileged accounts.

externalToo.label: Includes external people (customers, suppliers, partners)
externalToo.why: Kumulationseffekt §8.2.4 strongest here. With high-V data, V-Schutzbedarf typically lifts to sehr hoch. Identity verification, internal/external permission separation, MFA. NIS2 Art 21(2)(d) and (j).

internetExposure.question: How is the system reachable from the internet?

offline.label: Fully offline, no network connection
offline.why: Implementation hint: no internet exposure. External attack vectors eliminated; internal and physical threats remain.

internalOnly.label: Internal network only, no internet access
internalOnly.why: Implementation hint: internal exposure only. Grundschutz NET.1.1 applies.

vpn.label: Reachable only via VPN
vpn.why: Implementation hint: remote access via VPN. Grundschutz NET.3.3 and ORP.4 apply. NIS2 Art 21(2)(j) MFA proportionate.

internetExposed.label: Directly reachable from the internet
internetExposed.why: Implementation hint: severe. Public attack surface elevates threat exposure (BSI-200-3 Gefährdungslage), making the reduced Bausteine subset of Basis-Absicherung unlikely to be sufficient even with normal Schutzbedarf. Lifts the recommendation from Basis to Standard.

vendorSupport.question: Will security updates keep coming for this system?

active.label: Yes, the vendor actively maintains it and ships patches
active.why: Implementation hint: low Schwachstellen risk. Standard patch management sufficient (Grundschutz OPS.1.1.3).

mature.label: Yes, but patches arrive only occasionally
mature.why: Implementation hint: moderate Schwachstellen risk. Heightened own-responsibility for monitoring.

eolAnnounced.label: No, end of support has been announced
eolAnnounced.why: Implementation hint: known future Schwachstellen exposure. Migration or compensating controls required.

abandoned.label: No, vendor is gone or in-house build with no maintenance
abandoned.why: Implementation hint: severe. Unpatched-Schwachstellen risk justifies Standard-tier Bausteine even when Schutzbedarf is normal. Lifts the recommendation from Basis to Standard.

incidentHistory.question: Any security incidents with this system in the last 3 years?

none.label: No incidents, and we have logging or monitoring that would catch them
none.why: Implementation hint: substantiated absence. NIS2 Art 21(2)(f) effectiveness review periodically.

minor.label: No known incidents, but we don't actively monitor the system
minor.why: Implementation hint: unsubstantiated absence. Setting up basic logging is the first step. NIS2 Art 21(2)(f) recommended.

major.label: One past incident (minor or major)
major.why: Implementation hint: known Eintrittswahrscheinlichkeit. Lessons learned should be documented. Grundschutz DER.2.1.

repeated.label: Multiple or recurring incidents
repeated.why: Implementation hint: severe. High Eintrittswahrscheinlichkeit indicates structural weakness; reduced Bausteine of Basis-Absicherung insufficient. Lifts the recommendation from Basis to Standard.

replaceability.question: If this system disappeared tonight, when would you be running with an equivalent? (Buying, restoring from backup, or rebuilding all count.)

oneDay.label: Within a day
oneDay.why: Implementation hint: low BCP risk. Recovery feasibility good.

oneWeek.label: Within a week
oneWeek.why: Implementation hint: moderate BCP risk. Workarounds for transition needed.

oneMonth.label: Within a month
oneMonth.why: Implementation hint: significant BCP risk. Emergency planning required (Grundschutz DER.4).

irreplaceable.label: Not at all, or only as a long custom build
irreplaceable.why: Implementation hint: severe. Effectively no BCP recovery option means even normal-Schutzbedarf assets need Standard-depth protective measures. Lifts the recommendation from Basis to Standard.

result.heading: Risk assessment result
result.whySubtitle: These sentences form the basis of the Schutzbedarf and Absicherungsvariante justification. Use them unchanged or adapt them with the management body.
result.bausteineSubtitle: Indicative list from the IT-Grundschutz catalogue based on the recommended Absicherungsvariante. The canonical Modellierung step per BSI-200-2 §8.3 still happens in the operator's ISMS work.
result.measuresSubtitle: Art 21(2) NIS2 lists ten measures every entity in scope must implement ('shall include at least the following'). Implementation depth follows your Absicherungsvariante: Basis requires minimal evidence; Standard the full Grundschutz depth; Kern an additional risk-specific deepening per BSI-200-3 on the Kronjuwel asset.
result.cirNote: For the 11 entity types in scope of CIR 2024/2690 (cloud computing services, data centres, MSPs and MSSPs, DNS providers, TLD registries, content delivery networks, online marketplaces, search engines, social networks, trust service providers), the Annex sets out detailed implementing rules. Other entities apply BSI Grundschutz as the recognised methodology.
result.signoffBody: This assessment is binding only with management body sign-off (§38 BSIG, Art 20 NIS2). Enter name, date and signature on the printed document.

chart.title: Risk assessment as a radar chart, eight axes

disclaimer.heading: Legal note
disclaimer.body: This tool is an informational classification based on your inputs. It is not legal advice under the German RDG. The assessment becomes binding only with management body sign-off per §38 BSIG and Art 20 NIS2.
disclaimer.methodologyDisclosure: Per-asset Schutzbedarfsfeststellung aligned with BSI-200-2 §8.2 (assumes your Sicherheitsleitlinie §4 and Strukturanalyse §8.1 are already in place). Per-Grundwert classification (V/I/A) on the BSI normal/hoch/sehr-hoch scale, Maximum-Prinzip per §8.2.3, Kumulationseffekt per §8.2.4, and documented Schadensszenarien per §8.2.1. Vererbung, Modellierung (§8.3), IT-Grundschutz-Check (§8.4), and BSI-200-3 ergänzende Risikoanalyse remain follow-on work. Not a certification: that requires a third-party DAkkS-accredited audit.

a.label: Risk analysis and information system security policies

c.label: Business continuity (backup, disaster recovery) and crisis management

d.label: Supply chain security (supplier and service-provider relationships)

e.label: Security in acquisition, development and maintenance including vulnerability handling and disclosure

f.label: Policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of risk-management measures

g.label: Basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training

h.label: Policies and procedures on the use of cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption

i.label: Human resources security, access control policies and asset management

j.label: Multi-factor or continuous authentication, secured voice/video/text and secured emergency communications
